heroRole: Web developer in training, interested in creating accessible websites.
heroNote: Technology with purpose. Solutions made for people.
photoAlt: Portrait of Felipe Rodrigues de Sousa
aboutTitle: Programming is a way to open doors.
aboutText1: I come from the periphery of São Sebastião, in Brazil's Federal District. My dream is to transform not only my own life through programming, but also contribute to the lives of thousands of people.
aboutText2: I like technology because it can simplify everyday life. I care about social impact and solutions that put people first.
journeyIntro: My journey combines technology studies with professional experience that has brought me closer to people, processes, and everyday challenges.
studyText: My studies are broadening my perspective on computing and building a foundation for creating digital solutions.
workText: Experience in sales and finance, building communication, organization, and an understanding of people's needs.
skillsText: Connecting with people, constructive debate, teamwork, and simplifying problems are central to how I collaborate.
projectsText: Exercises and studies that are part of my Computer Science journey.
interestsIntro: Learning about the world and people also shapes the way I think about technology.
footballText: The game, the fans, and what happens when a team comes together around a goal.
philosophyText: Reflections on social questions and our inner lives.
contactText: I'm open to sharing ideas, learning, and hearing about new opportunities.
